correctness.rationale: The order parameter is nonzero, the sign-sum positivity inequalities exhaust all 16 local sign choices, and branch A/B/C/D inversion plus the unique x=9 merging determines the complete 0/1/2/4/6/8 equilibrium counts. Exact scalar differentiation gives all three thresholds. A quotient constrained symmetric Hessian and rank-one Schur complement give indices 0/1/2, with exactly one extra zero at each critical point. A separately executable verifier checks equations and eigenvalue signs on representative intervals; the infinite K ranges follow from analytic monotonicity, not finite tests.
